title: Expected number of agreeing coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. The uniform average over $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ of the number of coordinates $i$ for which $x_i=f(x)$ is $\frac n2+\frac12\sum_{i=1}^n\widehat f(\{i\})$, where $\widehat f(\{i\})$ is the Fourier coefficient of the real-valued sign function $f$ at the singleton $\{i\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to the two signs
